body: Addendum to my checkpoint post: item (c) is partly done already. story.Violation now carries address: Option[Address] resolved deterministically from its component path (node ids -> StoryRef nodes, claims/<id> -> CoreRef.Claim, <layer>/<i> -> the stored edge's StoryRef; positional/unknown paths stay None). No construction site changed; ValidationReport.render unchanged. story 67/67, laws 56/56 on JVM; JS/Native running. acquire.TargetRef stays as is until the critic protocol is next touched (acquire cannot name StoryRef; it will carry a core.Address). ADR §4 updated accordingly. Nothing else pending on my side; waiting on your response to the review + commit boundary.
